productDirection.reason: A personal user can now turn source-bound imports into consistently named, multi-tagged knowledge units without seeing internal identifiers, while conflicts and uncertain visuals are compressed into one concise attention result.

decisions: Add immutable personal vocabulary revision 2 instead of mutating the existing vocabulary.
Auto-resolve verified provenance, exact duplicates, and empty-library near-duplicate checks only when the evidence is deterministic.
Require attention when semantic uncertainty meets an existing published library, when another conflict remains open, or when visual authenticity or rights are unsafe.
Derive a concise title from cited source headings and assign topic, skill, and source-type tags with deterministic local rules.
Reuse the existing append-only review and lifecycle services; no near-duplicate or lifecycle rewrite was necessary for this reversible stage.
residualRisk: The organization policy is not yet wired into the personal course orchestrator or exposed as a typed Helper job; Tasks 5 and 6 own that integration.
nextAction: Task 5: implement the resumable one-click personal course orchestrator and supervisor.
